title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.22358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench

translated_title: PathFM：多元轨迹的快速生成式预测
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型在通用预测任务中日益流行。然而，大多数领先模型预测的是边际分位数，未指定未来轨迹之间的依赖结构。这一区别对于依赖轨迹的量（如累计需求、峰值负荷和事件发生时间）至关重要，而点预测和边际分数无法揭示这种结构。为了对这种依赖性进行建模，我们提出了PathFM，一种基于轨迹的预测模型，利用流匹配生成完整的未来路径。我们进一步将模型蒸馏至一到两步，并在多次采样之间共享历史注意力缓存。这些技术使得PathFM能够在大约相当于分位数模型单次查询所需的时间内，为单个时间序列生成多条路径。蒸馏后的采样器还使得直接优化校准损失成为可能。PathFM在既定的预测基准fev-bench上取得了具有竞争力的边际精度。
tldr: PathFM利用流匹配生成完整的多元未来轨迹以捕捉传统边际分位数模型无法刻画的依赖结构，并通过模型蒸馏与历史注意力缓存共享，实现了接近单次分位数查询速度的高效多路径生成。
en_tdlr: PathFM uses flow matching to generate complete multivariate future trajectories capturing dependence structures missed by marginal quantile models, while model distillation and shared history attention caching enable fast multi-path generation at roughly the speed of a single quantile model query.
